report.title: Match report
report.printHint: Choose “Save as PDF” in the print dialog. On a phone (Chrome): menu ⋮ → Share → Print.
report.tableControl: Summary: reception, set, dig, free ball
report.phaseTitle: Side-out and break point per set
report.phaseHint: Side-out: rally won after an opponent serve. Break: rally won on our own serve.
report.receptionHint: What happens after each reception grade? Attack = own attack in the same build-up, kill = the first attack scored.
report.setHint: Incoming ball = own touch directly before the set (reception, dig, free ball). A good set from a poor ball is worth more.
report.noInputSets: {n} set(s) without a recorded incoming ball are not included.
report.attackHint: Incoming ball = own touch directly before the attack, usually the set. Kill = attack point, efficiency = (kills − errors − blocked) / attacks.
report.serveHint: How well did the opponent receive our serves, and how often did we win the rally afterwards?
report.definitions: Effectiveness = share of the two best grades. Efficiency = (best grade − lost points) / all; lost points are errors, for attacks also blocked, for blocks also net/foot fault. Balance: points = aces, attack and block points; errors = lost points from all actions (including reception, set, dig) plus net, foot fault and card with a cause. Only completed rallies are counted.
